draftyak.mcp.McpEmailMessage.description: The shared parsed email metadata and delivery provenance with its required untrusted plain-text body. A truncated body must say so; no attachment bytes or HTML are added.

draftyak.entities.MessageDirection.description: Derived by the hub, never taken from a plugin. outbound needs the hub's own evidence: a send it verified, SENT mail it parsed, or on chat the owner's user id from its own auth check; on a device-hosted channel, a row the host reports as sent, which stays device-asserted. Every other message is inbound, including mail not parsed yet, mail without a single From, and mail from the owner's address without that evidence. So a message the hub can't place can only hold a send: an inbound message newer than a scheduled item's inbound watermark holds it under hold-if-reply, and being inbound grants nothing, neither known-contact status nor a verified sender.

draftyak.normalized-change.ProviderId.description: A provider's own id, opaque to the hub: visible ASCII, no spaces.

draftyak.entities.Mailbox.description: An address and the display name a header gave it. A mailbox the hub can't read as an EmailAddress, such as a bare MAILER-DAEMON or one with invisible characters, is left out.

draftyak.entities.EmailAddress.description: An address as the hub normalizes it: a dot-atom local part as given, without spaces, quotes or invisible characters, and a lower-case DNS domain with IDN labels as A-labels.

draftyak.entities.DmarcResult.description: DMARC from the topmost Authentication-Results whose authserv-id is the provider's own; any other result, or none, reads none.

draftyak.normalized-change.MediaType.description: A lower-case type/subtype without parameters, such as image/png.
